what: ClickHouse storage per row, measured from system.parts on data written by the M14 load tests (simulated fleet, 2026-09-30 13:04-15:16 UTC)
hardware: 4-vCPU x86_64 Linux container (not the target Mac); storage per row does not depend on the CPU
query: select table, sum(rows), sum(bytes_on_disk), sum(data_compressed_bytes), sum(data_uncompressed_bytes) from system.parts where active and database='telemetry' group by table
caveats: Simulated values compress differently from real sensor data.
Parts were not force-merged; duplicates not yet collapsed by ReplacingMergeTree are included, so this is an upper bound for the same data.
